title: Grimm Fairy Tales #84 Cover B Zenescope 2013 Snow Queen Brownfield Bogani
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light wear; small chip at the right edge of the front cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Grimm Fairy Tales #84 Cover B (2013), Zenescope Entertainment. Written by Troy Brownfield, art by Bogani and Paciarotti; Snow Queen ice-giant cover. $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Zenescope digital comics app ad.

Condition: bright cover with light wear; small chip at the right edge of the front cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
